verdicts.reason: I'd ship neither. They're almost the same scattered banner, and A is slightly less cramped. In both, the subhead and URL sit in the left column ahead of the headline, so the reading order is jumbled. The RSVP CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings tags, so it no longer stands out, and the venue copy is pushed to the far right, away from the date. The broken missing-asset fragment is still showing. B's tag pills are larger and jammed edge to edge, and the date is tighter under the headline. A spaces both a little better.
